title: Deferred review findings sweep: T-0268 lows, T-0270 idle-capture port, T-0274 leftovers, each closed with a test
spec:
Why: two merges were forced under the hackathon deadline rule (T-0264, T-0271) and their review findings were deferred (roadmap 3.1, P0-3). Inputs: bus:T-0268, bus:T-0270, bus:T-0274 results.
What (each item: fix + test, and one line in docs/checks/deferred-findings.md linking the finding to the commit):
1. T-0268 low: companion/src/window.test.ts:140 greps main.mts text for the partition. Replace with a behavioural test: extract the main-window BrowserWindow options into a pure function (e.g. `mainWindowOptions()` in companion/src/windowActions.mts) returning `webPreferences.partition === MAIN_PARTITION`, and assert `installGuards` is applied to `session.fromPartition(MAIN_PARTITION)` through an injected session factory in a unit test (mock electron). main.mts uses the function.
2. T-0268 low: the move to persist:apprentice drops old sign-in cookies: add the one-time note to companion/README.md under its release notes/known changes ("first launch after this update asks you to sign in once") and to docs/checks/one-app-desktop.md.
3. T-0268 low: src/lib/auth/context.ts:30,240 comment "absent means completed" is stale since forwardedUser.ts:64 always carries onboarding. Update the comment to the real contract, and add a test that a payload without the onboarding field (signed before deploy, inside the 30 s TTL) is treated the SAME way by AppShell and the onboarding page (pick: treated as "unknown, fetch server state"), so old and new payloads cannot disagree.
4. T-0270 med: src/lib/agents/admin.ts:523 supabaseIdleCapturePort untested: test it against the existing fake Supabase client used by other admin tests (table names, the `t` column on session_events/session_transcript/session_frames, lt/is filters, 42703 and missing-table behaviour).
5. T-0270 med: admin.ts:541 openCaptures runs three queries per open session with no cap: add a per-run batch cap (constant IDLE_BATCH, default 50, oldest first) and return `{ended, remaining}` so the cron reports when work is left; test the cap.
6. T-0270 lows: fileIdleCapturePort.endSessions honours endedAt (test); cron-ended sessions go through the same end path as /end (call the shared end helper or document in the route why not).
7. T-0274 low: e2e/live/live.spec.ts:338 theme restore matches a fixed name list (Dark, Light, System) instead of textContent.
No new dependencies. Do not touch src/proxy.ts (workspace switch task owns it), README.md, docs/DEPLOY.md, .env.example.
acceptance: companion partition test is behavioural: mainWindowOptions() returns the persist partition and the guards are installed on that session via an injected session factory (no text grep)
context.ts comment updated and a test proves a forwarded payload without onboarding is handled identically by AppShell and the onboarding page
supabaseIdleCapturePort is tested against the fake Supabase client incl. 42703 and missing-table; openCaptures is capped per run and reports remaining (tests)
fileIdleCapturePort honours endedAt (test); live.spec theme restore uses the fixed name list
docs/checks/deferred-findings.md maps each finding to its commit; README.md, docs/DEPLOY.md, .env.example untouched
.claude/hooks/tests-green.sh wt/THIS-TASK exits 0 and `npm run test:companion` exits 0 (state it)

constraints.scope_note: 22 files, above the five-file warning: the findings sit in five unrelated modules and splitting by module would mean five one-finding tasks each paying a full gate; split only if the executor reports conflicts
